track_decision_2026-08-13.note: Round 8 (Dami-authorized). Round 7 proved the dual-track combine path is a structural dead end (0/10, cited). Dami ruled: pick the single better track for us based on intel. PICK = Confidential Compute Apps. Grounded: ~7x fewer dedicated competitors (6 vs 44 primary repos), explicitly unowned whitespace (FCC lifecycle ops/observability #1, integration-test harness #4), and a NAMED user with verbatim-documented pain (FCC/Flare builders) — the market-reality evidence every prior round lacked. Interoperable single-track already produced 0/40 (R5-6) on the native-substitution wall.
target_whitespace: FCC lifecycle operations & proof observability that performs a real recovery
cross-primitive integration-test / failure-injection harness with judge-verifiable receipts
confidential vertical WITH a named buyer + proprietary workflow + privacy boundary not replaceable by ordinary encryption
